objective: Fail open on cache, fail closed on quota, and fail over once
success_conditions: A Redis read failure on the cache returns the upstream completion
A Redis write failure after a completion returns HTTP 200
A Redis failure while consuming quota returns HTTP 503 and does not call a provider
The live health endpoint returns HTTP 200
The ready health endpoint returns HTTP 503 when Redis is down
The ready health endpoint returns HTTP 200 when Redis is up and one provider is up
The ready health endpoint returns HTTP 503 when both providers are down
A retryable primary failure returns the secondary completion
A non-retryable primary failure does not call the secondary provider

tasks.description: Fail open on cache, fail closed on quota, add live and ready probes, and hop once on provider failure
Cover the failure policy with tests and update the guide pages that describe it
